annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as exceptionally profitable, with predicted price increases, anticipated gains, and an invitation to build a profit-seeking portfolio through a personal account. It also presents paid euro tiers tied to token quantities and splits, describes the offer as a limited business opportunity, and provides contact channels for further information, although the inputs do not establish what contacts would request or whether viewers paid or received returns.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The source links investing in OneCoin through a personal account with predicted price increases, anticipated gains and portfolio-building for profit. The frame also visibly shows One Academy trader tiers associated with token quantities and euro amounts. This supports a token purchase or participation pathway linked to appreciation or holding returns; it does not establish that any purchase or return actually occurred.
